# ssync_node (Resource)

The node records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `kind` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `sa_owner_id` (String)

### Optional

- `code` (String) Tengo source, for the kinds that run code
- `data_type` (String) provider:type, as the provider spec names it
- `description` (String)
- `icon` (String)
- `input_schema` (Dynamic) Derived from the code when left out
- `is_public` (Boolean)
- `links_schema` (Dynamic) Derived from the code when left out
- `output_schema` (Dynamic) Recorded by a node test when left out
- `required` (Boolean)
- `sa_parent_id` (String) The parent node; the node itself, a root, when left out
- `value_path` (String)
- `value_type` (Dynamic) Pinned by the kind when the node carries code
